mutations.because: reading the raw ref when the port's confinement rejects it returns the bytes of whatever an unsafe ref names, so a brief-supplied `/etc/passwd` or `../x` becomes a file-existence oracle over the whole repository — the exact failure resolveAssetPath exists to prevent.

inverting the ENOENT test warns about a logo that was simply never uploaded and stays silent about a corrupt one, so a present-but-unreadable brand asset renders with no logo and no diagnostic at all.

dropping the cause leaves the run failure naming no reason, so a beat whose scene was never uploaded (ENOENT) and one whose scene arrived corrupt become the same report, and the operator is told only that the read failed.
